		name = COLDWAR_EB.16.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 5 COLDWAR_EB_ai_intervenes = yes }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_EB.16 option b"
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_EB.16.b_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			From = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EB_restorable days = 365 value = 1 }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { global.COLDWAR_EB_restorable = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.COLDWAR_EB_restorable = THIS } }
			}
		}
	}
}

		name = COLDWAR_EB.15.c
		trigger = { NOT = { original_tag = From } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_EB.15 option c"
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_EB.15.d
		trigger = { NOT = { original_tag = From } NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_EB.15 option d"
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_EB.40
	title = COLDWAR_EB.40.t
	desc = COLDWAR_EB.40.desc
	picture = GFX_ICW_EVT_country_imp_1985_eb_security_breakdown
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_EB.40.a
		ai_chance = { base = 70 }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_EB.40 option a"
		if = { limit = { FROM = { is_subject_of = ROOT } } end_puppet = FROM }
		if = { limit = { FROM = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT } } remove_from_faction = FROM }
		declare_war_on = { target = FROM type = puppet_wargoal_focus }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_EB.40.b
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_EB.40 option b"
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_EB_let_go days = 365 }
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EB.41 } }
	}
}
